name: Central New Hampshire Snowmobile Club
tagline: Maintaining nearly 100 miles of trails in Campton, Ellsworth, and Thornton, NH
description: The Central New Hampshire Snowmobile Club trails are located throughout the towns of Campton, Ellsworth, and Thornton, New Hampshire. Our nearly 100 miles of trails cover the southern tip of the White Mountain National Forest. You can easily access the trails by getting off Interstate 93 Exits 28, 29 and 30, just north of Plymouth, New Hampshire. Our location makes it ideal to ride your snowmobiles in a vast area of Central New Hampshire. Some of the adjoining clubs next to us are the Baker River Valley Snowmobile Club, Squam Trail Busters, White Mountain Snowmobile Club, Bruhawachet Sno-Trackers and Asquamchumauke Valley Snowmobile Club.
trailReportSchedule: Trail conditions are posted every Thursday during riding season.
